question: What is the standard distance for males in a hurdle event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**110 m and 400 m**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The standard distance for men's hurdle events in athletics is **110 meters for the high hurdles** and **400 meters for the intermediate hurdles**.
 
• The 110 meters hurdles is a popular event in outdoor track and field competitions, especially in the Olympics and World Championships.
 
• The **400 meters hurdles** is another significant event in major athletics championships, including the Olympics and World Championships.
 
• The hurdles in the 110 meters event are set at a height of 1.067 meters (42 inches).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hurdles:**

 
 
• In hurdle races, athletes must sprint over a series of barriers placed at specific intervals.
 
• The hurdles are evenly spaced to ensure consistent rhythm and pacing.
 
 
 
• **Technique:**
 
 
• Proper technique in hurdling involves efficient clearance of the hurdles with minimal disruption to the athlete's running speed.
 
• Key aspects include the lead leg, trail leg, and arm movement.
 
 
 
• **Historical Background:**
 
 
• The men's 110 meters hurdles has been part of the Olympic Games since the first modern Olympics in 1896.
 
• The 400 meters hurdles was introduced in the 1900 Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Women's Events:**
 
 
• The standard distances for women's hurdle events are 100 meters and 400 meters.
 
• The women's 100 meters hurdles was introduced to the Olympics in 1972.
